messages:
maya-releng: heads-up: pushing py+ts SDK tonight 01:45 UTC. plan: canary 5% -> manual hold -> ramp. retiring sync v1, default will be async v2.

ian-eng: ack. will tag canary artifacts and create `legacy` dist-tag for npm.

zoe-docs: short deprecation banner ready, will stage it before canary.

kai-sre: monitoring set: watch 5xx > 0.8% sustained 5m and schema failures > 0.3% for 2 windows = rollback. will page oncall.

maya-releng: deploy-bot scheduled to run at 2025-03-05T01:45:00Z. request manual approve between canary and ramp.

deploy-bot: [automated] Preflight OK. Artifacts: `redwood-sdk-2.1.0-canary.tgz`, `redwood_sdk-2.1.0rc1.whl`. Waiting for manual publish trigger.

ian-eng: publishing canary now with flags `--cohort 5% --auto-promote false --stagger 10m`.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary live at 5%. Health pings posted to #devex.

kai-sre: first 10m green. p95 latency stable, schema failures 0.02%.

maya-releng: promoting to 25% in 15m if green. any objections?

ian-eng: none. note: legacy dist-tag in place.

kai-sre: at 25% we saw schema failures jump to 0.6% and a small 5xx uptick. escalating and pausing promotion.

maya-releng: pausing and rolling back. steps: 1) stop stagger in deploy-bot 2) `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk canary` 3) `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.10.2 latest` 4) publish py patch 1.10.3.post1 if needed.

deploy-bot: [automated] Stagger canceled. Canary tag removed. Cohort reverted to previous stable.

kai-sre: monitoring post-rollback looks normal. opening triage thread for root cause.

zoe-docs: will hold GA banner flip until patch and postmortem.

maya-releng: thanks team, reopening when root cause fixed.
